tool.name: RemoveLineNoise
tool.summary: Remove survey line (acquisition) noise. A zero-centred noise estimate is made from wavelengths between 2 x the smallest and 10 x the largest line spacing, within a wedge of directions about the line azimuth, scaled, and subtracted from the grid.
tool.usage: The same calculation as Remove line noise in the QGIS plugin.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).
param.pythonReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: azimuth
param.displayname: Azimuth of the survey lines (° clockwise from North)
param.dialogReference: Azimuth of the survey lines (degrees clockwise from north): the noise varies across them.
param.pythonReference: Azimuth of the survey lines (degrees clockwise from north): the noise varies across them.

param.name: line_spacing_min
param.dialogReference: Smallest line spacing in the survey (map units). The noise band starts at 2 x this spacing.
param.pythonReference: Smallest line spacing in the survey (map units). The noise band starts at 2 x this spacing.

param.name: line_spacing_max
param.displayname: Largest line spacing (map units, blank = same as smallest)
param.dialogReference: Largest line spacing (map units). Leave blank if the spacing is constant. The noise band ends at 10 x this spacing.
param.pythonReference: Largest line spacing (map units). Leave blank if the spacing is constant. The noise band ends at 10 x this spacing.

param.name: scale
param.displayname: Scale applied to the noise estimate
param.dialogReference: Multiplier applied to the noise estimate before it is subtracted.
param.pythonReference: Multiplier applied to the noise estimate before it is subtracted.

param.name: wedge
param.dialogReference: Half-width of the directional wedge in degrees: noise within this angle of the azimuth is kept in the estimate, with a cosine taper. Wider keeps more of the noise (and more of the geology).
param.pythonReference: Half-width of the directional wedge in degrees: noise within this angle of the azimuth is kept in the estimate, with a cosine taper. Wider keeps more of the noise (and more of the geology).

param.name: buffer_size
param.dialogReference: FFT buffer in pixels added around the grid before the Fourier transform, to reduce edge effects. 0 (the default) chooses it as in QGIS: the shorter side of the grid, up to 5000. A value greater than 0 is used as that upper limit instead.
param.pythonReference: FFT buffer in pixels added around the grid before the Fourier transform, to reduce edge effects. 0 (the default) chooses it as in QGIS: the shorter side of the grid, up to 5000. A value greater than 0 is used as that upper limit instead.
